verdict.rationale: Bento has no dedicated sandbox. Its documented pattern is a separate testing Site whose data stays isolated from the production Site, which teams use for development and QA (bento-docs-44, bento-docs-67, bento-docs-23). Smaller safeguards help: bulk imports that don't trigger automations (bento-docs-14), checking flow branches before they run (bento-docs-9), and Skills safety guidance for live account operations (bento-docs-29). missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test mode with test API keys, suppression of real email delivery during testing, agent/MCP-specific guidance for pointing at a test Site, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
